# Filmorax

> Filmorax is the cinematic and advertising production arm of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It produces commercials, brand films, cinematic content, product videos, event coverage and full post-production for brands in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf — from concept and script through the shoot to final delivery in every platform format.

## Services (Production)

- Commercial Production: commercials for TV and digital platforms — concept, script, casting, direction, cinematography and masters in all sizes.
- Brand Films: short cinematic films that tell the brand's story for launches, occasions and company channels.
- Cinematic Social Content: reels and short videos with film-grade lighting, photography and grading, in social platform sizes and rhythms.
- Product Videos: detailed product showcase, real usage footage and short performance cuts for e-commerce and advertising.
- Event Coverage: multi-camera filming of openings, launches and events, aerial footage when needed, and event aftermovies.
- Post-Production: editing, colour grading, sound design and mixing, motion graphics, subtitling and localisation, with delivery in every platform's versions and sizes.

## Selected work

- realme — promo film (2024).
- Domino's Pizza — commercial (2024).
- flynas — corporate video (2023).
